title: Software Engineering Intern - Waterloo University - Winter Session
description: Software Development Interns - Waterloo University Remote - Winter Session About Brave Brave is on a mission to protect the human right to privacy online. We’ve built a free web browser that blocks creepy ads and trackers by default, a private search engine with a truly independent index, private AI assistant, latest privacy and security features, and a private ad network (opt-in!) that directly rewards you for your attention. Already over 120 million people regularly use Brave for a faster, more private web. Millions more switch every month. The internet is a sea of ads, hackers, and echo chambers. Big Tech makes huge profits off our data, and tells us what’s true and what’s not. Brave is fighting back. Join us! Brave is hiring 2 Software Engineer interns this fall from Waterloo University to assist adding AI, security and privacy features to our products.  Software Developer Co-op - Internship Role One Contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of data-intensive systems and AI-powered services.  Key responsibilities include: Build and maintain ETL pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and loading structured and unstructured data across internal systems Develop backend services and tooling in Python and TypeScript to support data processing workflows and API integrations Integrate and optimize LLM inference pipelines, including prompt engineering, model serving, and evaluation of large language model outputs Deploy and manage containerized workloads on Kubernetes, including writing manifests, configuring autoscaling, and troubleshooting cluster issues Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve data quality, pipeline reliability, and system observability Software Developer (Privacy) Co-op - Internship Role 2 Contribute to the design, development, and shipping of privacy and security features in the Brave browser (based on Chromium). Key responsibilities include: Prototype, implement, and ship privacy-enhancing features end-to-end in C++ or Rust for the Brave browser Build browser-native privacy protections privacy-enhancing permissions and anti-fingerprinting defenses Navigate and contribute to an extremely large, complex codebase, applying knowledge of the Web security model and Chromium's architecture Work with Web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) to develop and validate browser features Collaborate async with a geographically-distributed, open source team using Git and GitHub Working at Brave - What we offer Ability to work remotely at an exciting and well-funded international startup headquartered in San Francisco Cutting-edge technology, allowing you to work with state-of-the-art tools and software solutions Competitive compensation of $6000.00 per month for 4 months. Great international exposure and team atmosphere If you are currently a student at Waterloo University, we would love to hear from you.  We offer flexible schedules to accommodate your studies.

title: Controllership Intern
description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the teams Stripe’s Controllership organization is responsible for the accurate and timely recording of Stripe’s business activities, the integrity of our financial reporting, and the scalable processes and controls that support our growth. We partner across Finance, Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, Legal, Tax, Treasury, and Internal Audit to understand Stripe’s products and operations, resolve complex financial issues, and maintain a strong control environment. We are hiring four Controllership Interns, with one role on each of the following teams: Accounts Receivable (AR), Controls, Product Accounting, and Corporate Accounting. In any placement, you’ll work with experienced teammates and cross-functional partners on meaningful accounting, data, systems, controls, or process-improvement work. Accounts Receivable (AR) supports invoicing, collections, cash application, and related financial operations through scalable, accurate, and auditable processes. Controls supports Stripe’s internal-control environment by documenting and assessing processes, identifying risks, supporting control testing, and helping teams design sustainable improvements. Product Accounting supports Stripe’s products by understanding their financial-data flows, evaluating accounting implications, and developing scalable processes Corporate Accounting supports Stripe’s close, financial reporting, corporate accounting processes, and control environment What you’ll do We’re looking for graduate students who want to deliver outsized impact while accelerating their growth in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. You’ll apply classroom learning to important accounting and financial-data problems at an industry leader in fintech. You’ll support meaningful work with an impact on Stripe and its users, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders. Depending on your placement, you may: Support core Controllership activities based on your placement, including accounts receivable operations, monthly and quarterly close, financial reporting, product accounting, or internal controls Prepare or support journal entries, account reconciliations, supporting schedules, variance analysis, and other accounting deliverables Analyze large financial and operational datasets using Google Sheets, SQL, AI tools, or other systems to identify unusual activity, data-quality issues, reconciliation breaks, control gaps, or operational trends Support invoicing, collections, cash application, or related order-to-cash processes, where relevant to your placement Research accounting questions and prepare clear supporting documentation under the guidance of experienced accountants Assist with the design, documentation, testing, and improvement of accounting processes and internal controls Support financial reporting, management analysis, and internal or external audit requests Partner with stakeholders across Accounting, Finance, Product, Operations, Engineering, Sales, Legal, Tax, Treasury, and Internal Audit to understand business activities and resolve issues Drive continuous process improvement, standardization, simplification, automation, and reporting enhancements Complete and present a case study or scoped project to your team and the broader Controllership organization Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements Currently enrolled at an accredited university pursuing a master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Information Systems, Business, or a related field Coursework, a project, or practical experience demonstrating a foundational understanding of accounting principles and financial statements Strong knowledge of Google Workspace or Microsoft Office tools, including experience analyzing large datasets Experience using SQL to query, analyze, and validate data through coursework, projects, or practical work Excellent written and verbal communication and organizational skills Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to bring structure to ambiguous opportunities in a fast-moving environment A self-starter who can drive results, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines A solution-oriented mindset and enthusiasm for establishing best practices Ability to build strong, collaborative working relationships with business partners Preferred qualifications Coursework or experience in Intermediate Accounting, audit, technical accounting, information systems, or data analytics Experience with Python, data visualization, or dashboarding tools such as Power BI or Tableau Familiarity with an ERP, financial-reporting, or workflow-automation tool Experience using AI for financial analysis or process improvement Interest in payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, digital assets, or technology Experience documenting a process or presenting analytical findings
